observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha mixing console box with 'PROFESSIONAL MIXING CONSOLE' and '8 MONO channel Mixing Console' printed on it.
The box also lists features: 7-band stereo graphic EQ, built-in mp3 player, USB 2.0 input.
Photo 1 shows the actual mixing console on top of the box. It has 8 channels with faders, knobs, and input jacks.
The console has red, blue, orange, and black knobs, and channel labels 1 through 8 are visible.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the left side of the console, showing channels 1-4 with faders and knobs.
The console appears to be in used condition with some visible wear and dust.
No power cord, manual, or accessories are visible in the photos.

read_from: photo 1 top left corner of console

claims.evidence: Photo 0 box and photo 1 console both show 'Yamaha' and 8 channels.
Photo 1 shows 8 XLR inputs (mic) and 8 1/4 inch inputs (line) at the top of the console.

claims.claim: l-r main xlr out & 1/4 inch out
claims.evidence: The rear panel with outputs is not shown in any photo. Cannot confirm presence of XLR and 1/4 inch main outputs.
No headphone jack is visible in the photos. The console may have one, but it is not shown.

Photo of all included accessories laid out next to the console.

risks.proof: Photo of the rear panel showing the main outputs.

risks.risk: Headphone jack may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the front panel showing the headphone jack, or a video of headphones connected and working.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear panel showing main outputs (XLR and 1/4 inch).
Video of the console powered on and functioning with audio output.
Photo of all included accessories (power cord, manual, cables).
Photo of the front panel showing the headphone jack.
response.reason: The console is identifiable as a Yamaha 8-channel mixer, but critical features like main outputs and headphone jack are not visible. Functionality and included accessories are unproven, which affects pricing. Proof is needed to confirm these aspects before pricing.
